en: Fixed false "needs input" notifications in `claude agents` after replying to a blocked session, and repeated ones after a background turn ended with no text and only basic tools such as Bash or Read
zh: 修复了在 `claude agents` 中回复被阻塞的 session 后出现错误的“需要输入”通知，以及后台回合结束时没有文本、仅使用 Bash 或 Read 等基础工具后重复出现该通知的问题
